findings.title: DHS order dated July 24, 2026 kept from public view until October Federal Register notice
findings.summary_md: The exclusion and removal order is numbered 2026-01 and signed by Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin on July 24, 2026, but was kept out of public view until the October Federal Register publication. The article confirms the order covers both DeepSeek models and third-party products built on them.

findings.title: DHS letter ordering DeepSeek exclusion dated June 26, 2026
findings.summary_md: The Federal Register notice includes a copy of a letter from Secretary Mullin ordering the exclusion of DeepSeek products on June 26, 2026, showing the ban has been in effect for months before the public October notice.
